name: my-app
description: An app built on the @marinoscar/platform-* packages, started from the platform starter.

scripts.setup: npm run build --workspace=cli && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js init
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=web && npm run typecheck --workspace=cli
scripts.test: npm test --workspace=api && npm run test:run --workspace=web && npm run test:run --workspace=cli
scripts.platform:check: npm run db:check --workspace=api && npm run db:compose:check --workspace=api && platform-infra sync --check
